name: What are the typical costs associated with AEO services for plumbers?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs associated with AEO services for plumbers?

acceptedAnswer.text: The costs for AEO services for plumbers can vary widely based on the scope of work and the provider's expertise. Factors influencing cost include the number of service areas (e.g., Houston, Phoenix), the amount of existing content that needs optimization, and whether new content creation is required. Some agencies offer monthly retainers ranging from a few hundred to several thousand dollars, depending on the intensity of the strategy and reporting. Project-based pricing is also common for specific content overhauls. It's crucial to get a detailed proposal outlining the services included to ensure it aligns with your budget and goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO service costs for plumbers vary based on scope, number of service areas, and content needs, with retainers from hundreds to thousands monthly or project-based pricing.
